method.noSourceTags: Profile /2 postprocessing before final encoding: every sourceTags array becomes firstTagIndex and tagCount; all other values unchanged. Peaks include construction of the full /2 projection, not an optimized range-only reader.
method.componentBytes: Compact UTF-8 JSON values, without property names. Arrays include brackets/commas; tag entries are summed individual objects; recordHeaders are summed objects containing only the eight requested header properties. Components overlap: vertices include nested record headers, fields and sourceTags; layers/blocks include their fields and tags. Do not sum these components.
method.fieldTags: Every tags array, including nested vertices and units.source; entries counted once per occurrence.
method.topLevelAccounting: Disjoint member bytes include property name and colon. otherIncludingPunctuation is the remainder; these totals sum exactly to outputBytes.
method.capacity: Exact serialized prefix in ascending original locator.tagIndex order, including nested VERTEX and SEQEND. All non-entity metadata, counts and full findings stay fixed; POLYLINE children are added incrementally. These are hypothetical wire-size prefixes, not publishable partial drawings or unchanged _Budget.add limits. Full-size identity and each threshold prefix were checked by actual serialization.
method.thresholds: 16 MiB = 16777216 bytes. Exact 20% reserve = floor(0.8 * 16777216) = 13421772 bytes (12.8 MiB). Literal 13.4 MiB = 14050918 bytes, only 16.25% reserve; both are reported.

caveats: All complete runs remain inside 2 GiB and 45 seconds, but all exceed the unchanged production output cap.

Range-only removal does not preserve every source tag value in fields: projections select a subset, and typed values do not retain raw lexemes. Unprojected/raw values remain only in the immutable original. This experiment is not a citation/schema compatibility claim.
